horoscopes.horoscope: You will make a great deal of progress which will help you set aside quite a chunk of money for lean times. There are yet more deals to be signed which will turn out to be landmarks in your business. Ganesha says that your current labours will bear fruits in the future. During the evening, you may take a stroll down memory lane or have a long mushy conversation with your loved one. Watching a romantic movie together or exploring fantasies on the bedroom will help you get closer to your sweetheart, feels Ganesha. You will be energetic in the first half of the day. However, during the second half you might spend lot of your energy in communication and related matters. Your mind will remain very active. You should communicate over things which can give you pleasure. Latter in the day Ganesha feels that you wouldn’t be able to crack good financial deals, even though your logical and analytical abilities would be better in the second half of the day. Raise your spirit today with Josh Groban’s inspirational song “You raise me up”. You need to be strong as you might face some tough challenges. Your bold approach may not work if you don’t mingle with the team. You need to focus on work and taking suggestions from colleagues will help.

It is very likely that you will stay physically alert and spiritually awake today, forecasts Ganesha. You will discover an artistic temperament as you engage in performing arts, designing, graphics and special effects. You will also appear extremely tempting to the opposite gender. Your foot-in-mouth comments will hurt your friends more than just a sprain on the foot, foresees Ganesha. Your partner might be looking for a harmonious evening. You need to be practical as well as sensitive to understand your loved one remarkably well, feels Ganesha. You will be in very good mood during the first half of the day. Your will feel very energetic as well. First half of the day is good to start gym or some body building plan. However, you may lose focus in the second half. As the day progresses, you may remain confused about your financial planning. You decision making power will become weak, specifically regarding money matters. So, avoid taking major financial decisions. No single mood will rule your attitude today. You will manage your stress well. You will express your views strongly, with your confidence reaching sky-high. Unfortunately, you may not be able to keep up the spirit at the end of the evening, feels Ganesha.

A busy day for you, predicts Ganesha, but it has little to do with work. Today, your mind is in a spiritual mode. You may want to make a few changes to the interiors of your house, mostly to get them in sync with the state of your mind. A romantic evening with your sweetheart in a sumptuous surrounding is likely, says Ganesha. You tend to do something new and different tonight as you want to make it a memorable one. A steamy rendezvous with your soulmate will rejuvenate your senses, foresees Ganesha. You may please your sweetheart with loads of humor tonight and enrich the bonding. While you will be patient and active during the first half of the day, in the second half of the day, you may feel bit weak or sick. During the second half of the day, you should not get stuck in one idea or though The things which you purchase during first half may not prove to be very lucky or good for you. However, you will be better placed in the second half in matters related to money and finance. You may lack confidence even though you turn out to be brilliant today. The morning will go slow but you will get back your energy only after the evening. You will be in the best frame of mind to write complex codes.

Business rivals will try to wipe out your prestige, but will fail. Bold people can steer clear of hurdles and you are bold. So with Ganesha’s grace you will be successful. People will praise your honesty and generosity. Your efforts alone beget you laurels. You will be excessively sentimental to your loved one who will fill you instantly with pleasure and excitement. You will get the full support of your better half tonight. You will also tend to share your obsession with him/her feels Ganesha. Health wise, Ganesha does not see any issue but laziness should be done away with. Ganesha feels that you should try and remain more creative in your thinking and approach today. It’s also a good day to talk at length with friends or loved ones. You may receive some money in the early part of the day. As the day progresses, you may start thinking of the ways as to where this money should be spent, says Ganesha. It is a day to coordinate with peers and colleagues. You will feel sensitive and give straightforward remarks during meetings, predicts Ganesha. This straightforward remarks may hurt people. You may fail to rationalise the things at the end of the evening feels Ganesha.

You will want some change in your daily surroundings, and this will manifest in the form of shopping for new clothes or home renovation projects and the like. You may also modify your daily routine. You need to take a closer look at your personal relationships today, says Ganesha. Chances are that at the end of the day, you may receive a wonderful gift and wallow in your lover’s attention because you take care of your sweetheart so much. You will feel great being on the arms of your sweetheart. You both will have a lovely evening ahead. There may be some clashes between mind and heart in the first half of the day. This conflicting situation which may make you feel bit tired. Ganesha feels that as time progresses, things will start improving and you will feel more at ease. You can make use of your talents to earn money as planets are in your favour. During the second half of the day, chances of financial gains through various sources are very high. You may start the day by attending the most crucial or challenging tasks of your assignment. You need to pull up your socks fast today as some important meetings may be called for, wherein you may discuss and reshuffle deadline of some projects.

In all likelihood, you will want to go into seclusion today, both mentally and physically. You have a knack to work yourself up to face challenges and gather your resources to come up trumps in unpleasant situations. However, you will not be able to go beyond your limitations. But Ganesha says a little devotion to the Lord could bring some change. Romance is on the cards tonight. You may propose your long desired heartthrob over a candlelit dinner. You don’t want to lose your love and strive to strengthen this relationship. A romantic and blissful night is ahead for both of you, foresees Ganesha. You will have high energy level in the first half of the day. However, in the second half, you may end up investing your energy behind talking to people or chatting with them. But if you waste your energy in arguments, it will drain you faster. You will be able to find stability and a sense of security in your life. Ganesha feels that today you will have a serious approach towards financial matters and thus chances of failure in financial management are nil. You will be the hero to your colleagues today. You will earn great appreciation from the higher authorities due to your punctuality, dedication, and managerial skills. Provided with so much importance and prestige, you may decide to stick to your organisation for the long run.

Remember the joint account you were going to open one of these days? Well, today is the day best suited for such decisions. Make the most of this propitious day and make well-informed plans concerning your future career growth. Ganesha gives his nod. Ganesha promises you a harmonious evening with your soul mate. You will be busy in exploring the romantic side of your lover. Don’t be surprised as Ganesha says that you may get some magical touch to stimulate your passion. You will be having a wonderful night. You will be energetic in the first half of the day. But you should control your anger. If you get angry, you could end up wasting your energy, feels Ganesha. Don’t take a major decision in the second half of the day. If you are thinking to begin some new work/business to expand your finances, Ganesha advises you to wait for better planetary transits. You will enjoy better luck during the latter part of the day. The confusions related to your current job will fade away as the day proceeds. Today is the right time to stay in touch with the colleagues or associates who are staying abroad. Perhaps, you may grab the golden key to some lucrative offers!

Today is that day when you make a fine show of your commitment to work and dedication to family. At work, the right job has landed on the right table – yours. At home, cement your place as the quintessential family man, advises Ganesha. You may not invest time for your loved one as professional pressures are likely to haunt your mind. You must make compromises and adjustments if you want a smooth sailing in your love life. Apologize to your sweetheart if anything hurts his or her feelings, says Ganesha. Ganesha advises you to watch your health. The workload may be heavy, and the work pressure may be too much. Hence, put in your best efforts to complete your tasks, but don’t overstrain yourself, as you may get totally exhausted today. You will take out more time to derive joy that money can or cannot buy. You will not be very calculative today. Ganesha feels this approach will make you feel happier and better. Things may not go well today, says Ganesha. You need to focus all your energies on the work you do. Make sure that you do not lose concentration even though some of the key decisions go wrong. Prudence is the key here.

You are inclined to be overprotective of your personal belongings. Sensational love affairs are plotting to hold you ransom. All the work you have been pushing off to do later will be completed reasonably on time. Ganesha sees a rather hopeful day in store for you. A good day as far as personal life is concerned, foresees Ganesha. With a true sense of understanding in your relationship, you will be drawn to your partner. You may not create magic all of a sudden but will be able to cultivate a new relationship, foresees Ganesha. On this dull day, you need to give priority to your health. The prevailing circumstances in your professional or personal life may cause anxiety. To relax your tired nerves, Ganesha advises you to consume healthy food and take adequate rest. Your over-spending is luckily under the shadow of practicality, which is good for you. Your approach towards money matters will be very practical and you will not spend money without thinking, says Ganesha. Your professional life will be flooded with projects. Postponing an important assignment in office will help you balance your tasks. Avoid working on a project where you are not confident. Taking a break from your work makes you feel good, says Ganesha.

You’re on the verge of losing hopes as you can’t bear the weight of work and responsibilities any more. But, like the strong individual that you are, you are not going to put your arms down without fighting fiercely. Also, your mental strength and physical stamina will be acknowledged and appreciated by one and all, predicts Ganesha. Be prepared to take the challenge in your love life. Avoid getting angry if your loved one pinpoints any of your negative points. You will definitely get supports from your sweetheart. You may have a pleasurable experience in your love life but emotional control is a must, reminds Ganesha. Try to be considerate towards everyone in your workplace and home. Think with an open mind and avoid being stubborn in your approach. Remain cautious during the latter half of today, as you are prone to some health issues. You stand a good chance to earn well through speculation. This is a good time to invest money in stock market. Ganesha feels that you should also review your past investments in stocks today. Slow down your pace today, advises Ganesha. The day doesn’t present the best time to take major decisions as your thoughts remain clouded and you may miss an important point. Avoid taking major decisions today. Be cautious as it is not a favourable day for investment, says Ganesha.

Today, you will revel in a lot of tender loving and care (TLC). You may also be able to solve certain baffling situations plaguing your peace of mind. Ganesha suggests that you meet people, as any associations you form today will prove beneficial in the long run. Tonight you will be at your imaginative best to live in a utopia. You will definitely be able to impress your partner. A sweet note from your heart would be the best gift your loved one has ever received. You will make a harmonious companionship tonight. Good day to plan your schedule for coming days. During the second half of the day, things may take a different turn and you may seem to be losing focus. However, it’s a very good day to invest energy in research and development. You may be spending money for books, communication-related objects, leisure activities and things that you can easily afford. Today, you may think a lot before making financial investments in any area. You will be so dedicated today that you may not take any break till you finish the pending work. You may feel apprehensive about fulfilling your primary responsibilities. You may feel the sense of pride after accomplishing some important milestones, feels Ganesha.

You will find yourself embroiled in tough situations at the work-place today. However, do not let it make you pessimistic. Even if things do not work out as and when they are meant to be, you will find that as the day progresses, things begin to fall in place of their own accord. Come evening, you should see yourself in a much more relaxed state of mind, after a hard day’s work, says Ganesha. You will create a wonderfully romantic atmosphere with your partner. Physically intimacy with your partner will certainly call for a steamy interlude, says Ganesha. You will love to be in your best mood to fetch ultimate satisfaction from your partner. Chances of falling sick are going to be higher today, so if you are on some medication, ensure that you don’t miss out on timings of medication. If you go to gym regularly, it’s time to allow yourself a break today. The day is not likely to push your mind/energy towards financial investments or purchase of luxurious items. You will not be very practical about financial matters but at the same time you will be restrained. You are determined to get into action to complete your tasks as soon as possible. Also follow a pros and cons of every step, reminds Ganesha. Else you may end up committing errors, foresees Ganesha. Analyze your situation carefully in order to make steady progress.
